popCulture.title: Telegony
popCulture.description: The lost cyclic sequel — Telegonus son of Circe kills Odysseus with a stingray spear, then brings Penelope and Telemachus to Aeaea.

popCulture.title: Telegonus
popCulture.description: The son who never knew his father until the spear struck — the Odyssey's darkest afterword in the Cycle.

popCulture.title: Epic Cycle
popCulture.description: The Telegony closes the Trojan sequence — after the returns, one last homecoming that ends a dynasty.
